name: Muesello's Elite Summoning Rune

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-11: No Time for Treason

disable: DC 20 Acrobatics check to approach without triggering the trap followed by DC 22 Thievery check (trained) to erase the rune, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 19) to counteract the rune
reset: The trap resets each day at dawn.

items.name: Summon Monster
items.text:
Trigger A creature enters the cloud of magical sensors.

---

Effect This trap summons a Sod Hound with the elite adjustment. The sod hound rolls initiative and remains for 7 rounds, after which the spell ends and the sod hound disappears. The sod hound also disappears if someone disables the trap before the duration expires. The summoned sod hound can use 3 actions each round and can use reactions, unlike most summoned creatures.

text: A cloud of invisible magical sensors in a 5-foot radius surrounds an invisible wall or floor rune the size of the creature to be summoned.
